architectural_question: What test decides whether the Workbench works: that its files exist, or that a fresh agent resumes useful work from them?
existing_adr_relationship: Complements ADR-0035/0040/0042; whole-Workbench continuity is broader than JSON notes.
recommendation: Fresh-agent continuity applies to the whole Workbench. ADR-0040 covers unfinished local context; it must not become the sole owner of the product promise.
why_adr_worthy: Fresh-agent continuity applies to the whole Workbench. ADR-0040 covers unfinished local context; it must not become the sole owner of the product promise.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: Extends ADR-0035 (reduced entry) and ADR-0040 (JSON notepads); neither states the outcome those mechanisms serve.

architectural_question: When may one of a passing check, a favourable review, and an owner instruction stand in for another?
existing_adr_relationship: ADR-0027 and ADR-0037 already separate authority, state and review effects.
recommendation: Authority, verified state and review authority are already separated explicitly. Clarify their relationship and child scope in the existing owners rather than add a fourth general authority record.
why_adr_worthy: No additional ADR recommended: Authority, verified state and review authority are already separated explicitly. Clarify their relationship and child scope in the existing owners rather than add a fourth general authority record.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: Generalises ADR-0023 (tools vs agents), ADR-0037 (independent review) and ADR-0027 (authority order) into the rule none of them states.

architectural_question: What evidence is allowed to support a claim that the Workbench improves an agent's work?
existing_adr_relationship: AGENTS, evals/README and outcomes/README govern outcome claims; ADR-0038 addresses setup evidence.
target: Evidence for claims of improved agent outcomes
recommendation: Preserve held-out comparisons, honest incompleteness and baseline integrity. This is a durable alternative to optimizing a structural self-score.
why_adr_worthy: Preserve held-out comparisons, honest incompleteness and baseline integrity. This is a durable alternative to optimizing a structural self-score.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: No existing ADR. AGENTS.md forbids weakening criteria; ADR-0038 rejects artificial pilots. evals/ and outcomes/ run with no decision record.

architectural_question: What must a harness feedback record state before its findings can be compared across releases, rooms and models?
existing_adr_relationship: REPORT_FORMAT already owns report identifiers and evidence limits; C carries general outcome-evidence rationale.
recommendation: Put evaluated/reviewer model fields and evidence states in the report contract. Retain the evidence rationale under C; do not import the Audit application or a mandatory central findings service.
why_adr_worthy: No additional ADR recommended: Put evaluated/reviewer model fields and evidence states in the report contract. Retain the evidence rationale under C; do not import the Audit application or a mandatory central findings service.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: Amends workbench/feedback/REPORT_FORMAT.md, which already scopes finding IDs and skill-copy provenance. Ports AU-0001/0002/0003/0004 reasoning upstream.

architectural_question: How may skills call each other, and what does a composed call inherit?
existing_adr_relationship: ADR-0036 covers stances, ADR-0027 covers authority. Composition merits a separate bounded rationale.
recommendation: Composition and source ownership can change independently. Preserve reusable primitives and distinguish invocation from authorization; do not adopt a metadata schema merely because one was suggested.
why_adr_worthy: Composition and source ownership can change independently. Preserve reusable primitives and distinguish invocation from authorization; do not adopt a metadata schema merely because one was suggested.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: Extends ADR-0036 (stances change method not authority) to the whole skill surface. CAND-F settled the tier boundary it composes across.

architectural_question: Does the Workbench ship promote/save/handoff and the lifecycle skills, or do they stay in KaydenClark/skills outside every room?
existing_adr_relationship: ADR-0031 covers runtime ownership; F settles skill source, installation, compatibility and local development.
target: Core, personal/shared and room-local skill ownership
recommendation: Use the final owner answer: one selected global core release with an explicit tested compatibility range; core source belongs exclusively upstream. Existing duplicate tracked copies are migration state.
why_adr_worthy: Use the final owner answer: one selected global core release with an explicit tested compatibility range; core source belongs exclusively upstream. Existing duplicate tracked copies are migration state.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: Contradicts nothing formally, but S-048 calls save 'unimplemented' while a working save and promote exist in ~/.claude/skills.

architectural_question: What does each setup operation promise to preserve, and what must it check before it mutates anything?
existing_adr_relationship: Extends ADR-0031/0032 with lifecycle preservation contracts already implemented across setup tools.
target: Preservation contracts for genesis, adoption and upgrade
recommendation: Different preconditions and allowed effects are a durable architectural choice. Link runtime ownership to ADR-0031; source validation is required for every consumed lane.
why_adr_worthy: Different preconditions and allowed effects are a durable architectural choice. Link runtime ownership to ADR-0031; source validation is required for every consumed lane.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: Extends ADR-0031 and ADR-0032. S-032, S-042, S-044 and S-045 TK-001 implement or contest parts of it with no ADR.

architectural_question: When someone says 'the room is on v3.1.3', which of five different facts is being claimed?
existing_adr_relationship: Extends ADR-0031 receipt identity; S-031/039 and current diagnostics evidence distinct layers.
target: Identity across release, adoption, installed bytes and runtime
recommendation: Each evidence claim names the state it proves. Historical adoption provenance cannot stand in for current tools, skills, runtime or downstream acceptance.
why_adr_worthy: Each evidence claim names the state it proves. Historical adoption provenance cannot stand in for current tools, skills, runtime or downstream acceptance.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: Extends ADR-0031's receipt model; ports AU-0004 upstream. S-031, S-039 and S-042 implement layers of it.

architectural_question: What proves that work is recoverable, integrated and complete?
existing_adr_relationship: ADR-0037/0039 and AGENTS Branch Completion already govern reviewed destination and containment.
recommendation: Exact candidate, actual destination containment and safe cleanup already have behavioral owners. Add rationale there and preserve remote uncertainty; do not create another generic completion gate.
why_adr_worthy: No additional ADR recommended: Exact candidate, actual destination containment and safe cleanup already have behavioral owners. Add rationale there and preserve remote uncertainty; do not create another generic completion gate.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: Extends ADR-0037 (exact-candidate review) and ADR-0039. AGENTS.md already states the containment rule without its rationale.

architectural_question: What does a harness-only change do when the target has no runnable green baseline for reasons the change cannot fix?
existing_adr_relationship: S-041 records the accepted alternative; ADR-0020 scopes what a check may block.
target: Unavailable baseline for a bounded harness-only change
recommendation: Record-and-proceed is an explicit alternative selected in S-041. Retain the closed reason vocabulary and independent review; red is not reclassified as unavailable.
why_adr_worthy: Record-and-proceed is an explicit alternative selected in S-041. Retain the closed reason vocabulary and independent review; red is not reclassified as unavailable.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: Links ADR-0020 (a check blocks only what it evaluates). S-041 is complete and records the owner's explicit choice.

architectural_question: How much may a room's controls diverge from the template they derive from before that divergence must be decided rather than discovered?
existing_adr_relationship: S-034/036, LEXICON Control fidelity and current report tests already state and exercise the boundary.
recommendation: Preserve fixed wording when filling placeholders and expose changed/dropped rules. Divergence remains legitimate when deliberately decided; fidelity stays a report, not a universal blocker.
why_adr_worthy: Preserve fixed wording when filling placeholders and expose changed/dropped rules. Divergence remains legitimate when deliberately decided; fidelity stays a report, not a universal blocker.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: No existing ADR. S-034 (fidelity report) and S-036 (permission model correction) are both complete; Example_Workbench is the live reference.

architectural_question: Does a record's meaning depend on the host that checked it out?
existing_adr_relationship: S-037 and parser tests own line-ending semantics; a new decision record is not required.
recommendation: Line terminators and read-only parsing are a portable syntax contract adequately owned by docs and tests. No separate architectural alternative needs a new ADR.
why_adr_worthy: No additional ADR recommended: Line terminators and read-only parsing are a portable syntax contract adequately owned by docs and tests. No separate architectural alternative needs a new ADR.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: No existing ADR. S-037 is complete with tests covering LF, CRLF and CR frontmatter.

architectural_question: What makes parallel agent work safe, and what does 'different task' fail to guarantee?
existing_adr_relationship: AGENTS and S-020 already cover repository/spec/shared-file write ownership.
recommendation: S-020 already records one writer across repository/spec/shared-file lanes. Clarify current scope and serialization examples without inventing a global lock service or mandatory agent teams.
why_adr_worthy: No additional ADR recommended: S-020 already records one writer across repository/spec/shared-file lanes. Clarify current scope and serialization examples without inventing a global lock service or mandatory agent teams.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: AGENTS.md carries a one-line rule for spec/Taskboard state; no ADR gives it scope or rationale.

architectural_question: Notes are local-only and gitignored, but the owner works on two machines. What carries objective continuity across them?
existing_adr_relationship: Explicitly narrows ADR-0040 local-only and implements the connection identity deferred in ADR-0041.
target: Optional private Git transport for session continuity
recommendation: The owner selected workbench_sessions, a stable Workbench identity, selected live collections, conflict preservation and explicit remote confirmation. Transport changes recoverability, not authority or promotion.
why_adr_worthy: The owner selected workbench_sessions, a stable Workbench identity, selected live collections, conflict preservation and explicit remote confirmation. Transport changes recoverability, not authority or promotion.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: ADR-0040 selects JSON and local-only and deliberately leaves transport unselected; ADR-0028 makes tracked checkpoints the only current crossing.

architectural_question: Node stays, or the runtime migrates to Python.
existing_adr_relationship: RUNBOOK and source use Node; latest owner answer selects it explicitly. Recorded factual rationale needs correction.
recommendation: Keep the explicit Node decision and the historical rationale, while correcting the factual claim that Node has no deserialization step or Python is intrinsically unsuitable for JSON.
why_adr_worthy: Keep the explicit Node decision and the historical rationale, while correcting the factual claim that Node has no deserialization step or Python is intrinsically unsuitable for JSON.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: No ADR. All portable runtime tooling is Node .mjs; only the evals lane is Python.

architectural_question: What must a host provide before the Workbench claims to work on it, and does the harness ship provider-native enforcement or stay prose plus tools?
existing_adr_relationship: Extends ADR-0005/0023/0029; native enforcement adapters differ from existing discovery and eval-provider adapters.
target: Minimum configured-host capability and evidence boundaries
recommendation: The owner chose a small capability contract; actual requirements remain to be specified and agreed. Keep host enforcement and agent reliability separately evidenced. Native enforcement adapters are outside the core commitment for now.
why_adr_worthy: The owner chose a small capability contract; actual requirements remain to be specified and agreed. Keep host enforcement and agent reliability separately evidenced. Native enforcement adapters are outside the core commitment for now.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: ADR-0005 requires a running consumer but names none for provider behavior; skillPolicy.discovery is the only provider-aware declaration.

architectural_question: If checkpoints retire, what becomes the privacy-checked crossing from local working record to durable evidence?
existing_adr_relationship: Partially supersedes ADR-0028; ADR-0040 already permits direct owner promotion; S-048 owns retirement.
recommendation: Partially supersede ADR-0028: freeze historical checkpoint references, remove future checkpoint promotion after consumer migration, and preserve rollback storage separately.
why_adr_worthy: Partially supersede ADR-0028: freeze historical checkpoint references, remove future checkpoint promotion after consumer migration, and preserve rollback storage separately.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: ADR-0028 makes checkpoints that crossing; S-048 (planned) proposes retiring them; ADR-0040 points at reconciliation into owners instead.

architectural_question: What happens to the Foundry, Flight, CAS, Lighthouse and CIC designs now that the Workbench is standalone?
existing_adr_relationship: ADR-0015/0026 already exclude required extension machinery. Retain historical detail outside base ADRs.
target: Historical source packet; original extension owners
recommendation: ADR-0015/0026 already establish the base boundary. Preserve all historical records and corrections here; do not create an upstream archive Design Concept merely to park abandoned mechanisms.
why_adr_worthy: No additional ADR recommended: ADR-0015/0026 already establish the base boundary. Preserve all historical records and corrections here; do not create an upstream archive Design Concept merely to park abandoned mechanisms.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: Executes ADR-0015 and ADR-0026. Collapses 35 recovered items plus the superseded producer topology into one decision and one archive article.

architectural_question: Where does an acknowledged-but-unfinished finding live so the entry route still reaches it?
existing_adr_relationship: ADR-0042 owns reachability; AGENTS owns current spec state and completed evidence preservation.
recommendation: Reachability of an acknowledged obligation extends the existing navigation and ownership contract. Completed evidence stays intact; this does not authorize creating work from every finding.
why_adr_worthy: No additional ADR recommended: Reachability of an acknowledged obligation extends the existing navigation and ownership contract. Completed evidence stays intact; this does not authorize creating work from every finding.
first_pass_existing_adr_relationship: Extends ADR-0035 (entry) and ADR-0042 (traversal). S-045 exists because seven follow-ups survived only as prose inside completed specs.
